title: TAI semantic factor validator repair
objective: Eliminate false-negative live acceptance for substantive agricultural answers by validating independent semantic factor groups instead of requiring two literal terms from a narrow list.
boundaries: Do not weaken source, model identity, answer mode, stream completeness, subject relevance, minimum answer length, forbidden platform article, RU/EN/ZH or mobile Chromium assertions
A substantive answer still requires at least two independent factor groups
Synonyms within one factor group count once, preventing repeated nutrient names from satisfying a two-factor requirement by themselves
The cucumber yellow-leaves scenario must recognize nutrition, water/root, disease/pests and climate as independent diagnostic groups
No production behavior, model prompt, authority boundary, write path or infrastructure is changed
Production completion requires exact-head terminal PASS, merge to current main, protected exact-main activation, all endpoint and mobile scenarios PASS and finalization accept
